etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from French glacier, from Franco-Provençal gllaciér, from Vulgar Latin *glaciārium, a derivative of Latin glaciēs (“ice”), of uncertain origin. First attested in English in 1744 per the OED.

definitions.definition: (geology) A large body of ice which flows under its own mass, usually downhill.
(mountaineering) An area of a mountain where snow is present year-round.
